assertions.name: no_i11_violations
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = no script uses _VALIDATION as a prediction input)
assertions.source: Closure gate: every script using a _VALIDATION constant either uses it only as comparison target or carries an explicit CLASS-A acknowledged-anchor banner.

description: I11 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: scripts that import M_*_MEV_VALIDATION constants from codata_constants.py are classified by usage. The validation constants are tagged 'DO NOT USE AS PREDICTION INPUTS' in the source; using them outside `pred - VAL` / `abs(...)` / `expected=VAL` style comparison contexts is an I11 violation unless the script's docstring carries a CLASS-A acknowledged-anchor banner (typical for the M_N anchor pending Workplan-0b). Per-script classification surfaces the violation queue for follow-up.
